chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Abū Jaʿfar, from his father, from Wahb ibn Wahb, from Jaʿfar, from his father عليه السلام: that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed salat over a جنازة, and when he had finished, some people came to him and said, “O Messenger of Allah, we did not catch the salat over it.” So he said:
Salat is not performed over a جنازة twice; rather, supplicate for him.
Thus, the appropriate understanding of this narration as well is the same as what we have already mentioned regarding the first report.

key_terms.الْخَبَرِ الْأَوَّلِ: the first report previously cited in the chapter
key_terms.جِنَازَةٍ: the funeral bier or deceased person over whom funeral rites are performed
key_terms.مَرَّتَيْنِ: two times; indicating repetition of the funeral salat
key_terms.يُصَلِّي: to perform salat, here meaning funeral salat

ai.seo_question: Can salat over a جنازة be performed a second time if some people missed it?
ai.summary: This report states that salat over a deceased person is not to be repeated once it has already been performed. Those who missed the funeral salat are instead instructed to make du'a for the deceased. The closing note indicates that this narration is to be understood in the same manner as the first report in the chapter.
